answer.explanation: The visible log events show no errors, timeouts, throttling or access-denied messages across all four functions. Durations are stable and well within limits, and Max Memory Used stays below the configured memory size on every invocation. Compression and Thumbnailer use 1024 MB against roughly 102-110 MB used, which is over-provisioning rather than a fault. About 4,300 events were truncated, so this conclusion covers only the visible portion of the window.
